text: Let us recap. The speed of a mechanical wave is the square root of the right elastic modulus over the density. Sound races through steel at about five thousand metres per second, and through water at about fifteen hundred. Fluids carry only longitudinal waves. Newton assumed isothermal changes and got two eighty, sixteen percent low. Laplace showed they are adiabatic, so B is gamma P, giving three thirty one. The speed depends on temperature, not pressure, rising by about zero point six one metres per second per degree.
